title: P2P selection and playback fix
notes: Fixes P2P selections that previously appeared to do nothing. Movies and the Add-ons library now use the same embedded engine, magnet selected-file parameters are parsed correctly, the player waits safely for libtorrent storage, and a visible preparation or error message is shown. The in-place upgrade preserves each device's add-ons, Recently Watched list, favourites, progress and settings.
